messages:
maya-ops: quick q — filling out a customer security questionnaire for a private deployment. they asked: "are logs redacted before leaving customer network?" also asked for subprocessors list + who signs off on KMS usage. anyone have a concise set of answers i can paste?

tim-sec: short answers — yes: for Private we run the redaction pipeline inside the customer VPC by default; PII patterns (emails, ssns, api keys) are masked before any external sink. subprocessors: core infra cloud provider, monitoring, and analytics partners only (we have canonical list). kms: we support customer-managed keys (recommended). if they don't provide one, RIF-managed KMS is used with minimal-access service accounts. subprocessors and KMS decisions need security + legal approval.

sasha-privacy: add: redaction rules = emails, ssns, credit_card, oauth_tokens. note we do NOT automatically redact model outputs unless the customer opts in for output-deid. link to internal redaction doc: https://internal.redwood/docs/log-redaction (internal).

ben-eng: can we give them a short config snippet they can paste? something like:
```json
{
  "redaction": {
    "default_mask": "****",
    "fields": ["email", "ssn", "credit_card"]
  }
}
```

tim-sec: yep that works. also include retention note: default log retention for Private is 30 days, configurable by contract. and include that audit logs are kept separate and encrypted at rest.

maya-ops: perfect. subprocessors — who owns the canonical list? i need a CSV to attach to the questionnaire.

sasha-privacy: i maintain the proc list. i'll export current CSV and add the new monitoring entry we agreed on. will loop in legal for DPA sign-off.

sec-bot: NOTE: subproc registry updated: added datadog-logs (monitoring) — pending security review.

tim-sec: reminder: for SOC2/ISO answers we also need a simple dataflow diagram showing where logs flow (VPC -> redaction -> storage/monitoring). customers asking for SIEM integration require a scoped diagram and an MDR contact.

ben-eng: i can sketch the dataflow diagram in draw.io, but need network CIDR and the infra contact. pinging infra-owner next.

maya-ops: assigning: @ben-eng for diagram, @tim-sec for final security approval text, @sasha-privacy to attach proc CSV + redaction doc. i'll assemble and send the questionnaire responses later today.

sasha-privacy: :thumbsup: i'll update the registry and drop the CSV link once done.

maya-ops: thanks all — this helped a lot, will post final payload to the customer thread when complete.

ben-eng: quick Q — should i include the sample config snippet in the questionnaire or only the high-level statement?

tim-sec: include both: high-level statement + the snippet as an appendix. legal likes the high-level for contracts, engineers like the snippet.

maya-ops: awesome. closing this thread once i upload the files.
